releaseNotes:
Ahoge 0.1.2 — Reconstructed reading experience

• Artwork-led Library with reading continuity and an adaptive collection.
• Discovery-first Explore, source browsing, and global search.
• Rebuilt manga details with a primary Read/Resume action and dense chapter browsing.
• Reading timelines for Updates and History, plus an offline shelf and clearer download controls.
• Reconstructed reader controls, onboarding, More, settings, and management surfaces.
• Dynamic Type layouts, named accessibility controls, and motion/contrast-aware presentation.
• Includes the native MangaDex and WeebCentral source runtimes added since 0.1.1.
• Existing reader-engine, persistence, download, and security behavior is preserved by the presentation reconstruction.
